railway_interaction_pattern.2026_09_19: Documented fresh threads in existing projects.
railway_interaction_pattern.new_finding: A Railway fresh thread is not necessarily a clean writer context. The agent loaded and automatically updated project-level working memory. In Mission Control, a fresh thread reproduced a pre-existing Version 8 prose architecture that was absent from the immediate prompt.
railway_interaction_pattern.controlled_observation: In a newly created empty Railway project, the first minimal continuation reverted to aphorism/list/timing. After same-project corrections were stored, the identical minimal prompt in a later fresh thread improved. This is strong evidence that project memory conditions generation, though one sample per condition does not quantify its effect.

working_diagnosis: The September 19 source was coverage-shaped. Its four jobs remained separable even after conversion from bullets to prose, so Railway regularized them into one sentence per job.
The September 15 source was thought-shaped. Its functions belonged to one causal development and could be narrated as one movement across a full paragraph.

Fresh Railway threads in pre-existing projects were falsely treated as clean. Persistent project memory is a hidden interaction variable and makes cross-project/fresh-thread comparisons non-independent.
The exact September 15 Railway interaction cannot be reconstructed, so project memory is a discovered confound and plausible contributor—not a proven historical explanation.

strongest_autonomous_continuation.text: Sometimes I reread what I wrote and realize the sentence I thought was the most honest one is actually the sentence where I’m trying hardest to make them feel bad. I don’t always delete it right away, either. I’ll just sit there looking at it, because maybe the feeling underneath it is real, but the sentence itself is doing something else, and I’m still trying to work out what.

internal_audit.note: Strongest autonomous continuation: one live movement, no checklist, no invented chronology, and an unresolved stopping point.

fresh_target_transfer.text: So maybe the first step isn’t becoming that adult all by yourself. Maybe you have to borrow someone else’s adulthood for a while—not just have them care for you, but notice what they’re doing, let them help you do some of it, and then try one small part yourself. I mean, that may be how the adult gets inside you in the first place: not because you suddenly know how to parent yourself, but because you’ve been close enough to someone doing it that, little by little, you can begin to do what they did.

internal_audit.note: Fresh-target transfer: integrates the Episode 005 learning sequence into one causal explanation rather than allocating one sentence per source unit.

strongest_source_driven_p3.text: And I think part of not sending it yet is going back for the person who wrote that first version. You don’t snatch the pencil away because they got upset and made a mess of the sentence. You put your hand over theirs for a minute and help them write it in a way the other person might actually be able to hear, while the upset is still there and they’re still trying to say what happened.

internal_audit.note: Strongest source-driven P3: preserves the image, keeps the hurt present, and does not replace the ending with a lesson.

strongest_source_driven_p3.provenance_limit: Substantially realizes owner-supplied P3 cognition and therefore is not evidence of autonomous continuation.
